payload.claim: The Context section claims DESIGN.md §5.4 "now says 'One extra test run, or two when the second subset below holds a name.'" The actual text at DESIGN.md:1042 reads "One extra test run, or two when both subsets below hold a name" — not "the second subset." This is a misquote presented in quotation marks as if verbatim. It doesn't mislead the build: the Notes section and criterion 3 separately and correctly describe the case where the first subset is empty and the second subset alone runs (one call), so the acceptance criteria are unaffected by this paraphrase error.
